name: Faceted Glass
description: The frame is seen through a pane of irregular cut-glass facets, each one showing its own shifted, zoomed and tilted view of the picture, with bright beveled edges and thin dark seams; the facets turn to the second clip one by one, then the glass flattens out and clears. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: facets
params.description: Number of facets across the height of the frame

params.name: refraction
params.description: How far each facet shifts its view of the picture at the peak

params.name: bevel
params.description: Strength of the highlights and shadows along the beveled edges, and of the glint as each facet turns

params.name: highlight
params.description: Color of the light caught by the bevels (alpha: strength)

params.name: seed
params.description: Random seed: another value gives other facets, turning in another order
